text:
Olivia Park: hey hi! I'm Olivia (she/her) — starting today on DevEx. Moved from Portland. Carrying a suspiciously large amount of cheese, a tiny cactus named Spike, and a bongo I insist is a hobby. Pastrami > everything. Happy to be here :wave:
Sam: welcome!! :tada: quick question — coffee or tea person? also we have a very unofficial bagel/pastrami scene at lunch :eyes:
Olivia Park: big coffee, but i will never say no to iced tea. and pastrami forever. also my bongo might make an appearance during team happy hour 🥁
Priya S.: pastrami stan here too. 12:30 is our usual lunch wave, some of us eat at the bench by the courtyard — wanna join? :sandwich:
Maxine: welcome olivia! :heart_eyes: spike (the cactus) is invited to the plant swap next Friday. where's your desk so people can find you?
Olivia Park: desk D-3, window side. i'll bring a small sticker for anyone who wants to christen the bongo.
Dana: badge should be waiting at reception under your name. ping me if it's not there and i'll go rescue it :running_man:
Juno: hi! onboarding style q — do you prefer standing walkthroughs (short + many) or sit-down deep dives? we try to match folks to buddy sessions accordingly
Olivia Park: i'm into short standing walkthroughs for the first few, save the sit-downs for docs and weird config deep dives. also down for a pastrami pilgrimage at lunch :)
HR Bot: Reminder — New Hire Orientation is at 3:00pm in Conf C. Please bring a photo ID. RSVP link: <https://company.ok/orientation>
Sam: oof timing works for me. pastrami or bagel for the victory lunch poll?
Maxine: pastrami :+1:
Priya S.: bagels if too many pastrami eaters make me jealous :bagel:
Olivia Park: pastrami wins in spirit. i'm thrilled to meet y'all — thanks for the warm welcome :sparkles:
Dana: super excited to have you. we'll swing by D-3 after standup to say hi :wave:
